# Dataset catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_catalog.py from fineweb_polygons.registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The public dataset is [NoeFlandre/fineweb-polygons on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/NoeFlandre/fineweb-polygons).
The source code and runnable contracts are in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/NoeFlandre/fineweb-polygons). The machine-readable catalog is
[`metadata/catalog.json`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/NoeFlandre/fineweb-polygons/blob/main/metadata/catalog.json).

Every direction publishes under `data/<direction>/<version>/`, with its
manifests under the matching `metadata/<direction>/<version>/` prefix.
A changed rule gets a new version and a new path; published paths are
never reused for different content.

## FineWeb polygon retrieval

**ID:** `direction-1-fineweb-retrieval` &middot; **Status:** frozen &middot; **Latest:** `v10`

Documentation: [`docs/directions/fineweb-retrieval/README.md`](https://github.com/NoeFlandre/fineweb-polygons/blob/main/docs/directions/fineweb-retrieval/README.md)

| Version | Splits | Config | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v1` | train | `v1` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v1/` | Named polygon exact matching; excerpt-only release. |
| `v2` | train | `v2` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v2/` | Meaningful in-boundary exact matching with full text. |
| `v3` | train | `v3` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v3/` | All meaningful areas with strict URL-and-text matching. |
| `v4` | train | `v4` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v4/` | All meaningful areas with text-only matching. |
| `v5` | monaco, liechtenstein | `v5` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v5/` | Specific polygon names with country-in-text matching. |
| `v6` | monaco, liechtenstein | `v6` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v6/` | V5 names constrained to a 500-character local text span. |
| `v7` | monaco, liechtenstein | `v7` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v7/` | Exact sentence lists added to the V6 rows. |
| `v8` | monaco, liechtenstein | `v8` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v8/` | Document-level topic-vocabulary filtering of V7. |
| `v9` | monaco, liechtenstein | `v9` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v9/` | Sentence-level topic filtering near polygon evidence. |
| `v10` | monaco, liechtenstein | `v10` | `data/direction-1-retrieval/v10/` | Local LFM land-use classification of V9 candidate sentences. |

## How to inspect a release

1. Open the version's `README.md` beside its data for the standalone
   contract.
2. Open its manifest under `metadata/` for source fingerprints,
   settings, counts, and the output hash.
3. Load it by configuration name, for example
   `load_dataset("NoeFlandre/fineweb-polygons", "v10")`.
